auto_clusters.method: average-linkage agglomerative clustering on cosine distance of concat[unit(W_enc) || unit(W_dec)]

svd_geom.method: average-linkage agglomerative clustering on cosine similarity of concat[unit(W_enc) || unit(W_dec)]

spectral_clusters.method: spectral clustering on max(cosine,0) mutual-kNN affinity; L_sym smallest evecs → k-means (no row-normalize); cosine = precomputed cosine
